local_rule_repair.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: image 1, a small native-scale detail of a historical hand-drawn engraved ornament; image 2 shows the same detail on white for inspecting its fine ink. Extend ONLY the LOWEST thin horizontal framing rule: its current ink ends about two thirds of the way across; complete the missing right-hand segment so it ends directly below the right endpoint of the thicker upper rule. Continue the existing lower rule's exact warm gray-brown color, faint uneven engraved texture, tiny hand-drawn wavering, weight and alignment. Make the join at the existing endpoint continuous and invisible. Keep the thicker upper rule and ALL leaf/stem fragments above it unchanged. Do not create vertical ends, a rectangle, another line, a thick stroke, perfectly uniform modern geometry, or any other marks. Return the same wide shallow framing, original proportions, a small transparent margin, and genuine transparent background; the only added ink is the missing end of this original thin lower rule.
